en.title: Printable Halloween Activities for Kids at Home
en.intro: Help Pip prepare a friendly Halloween paper theatre. Follow printed clues, make paper actors and share information to complete a cooperative performance. For ages 6–12, with an adult host.
en.storyTitle: The posters are torn. The stage is waiting.
en.story: Pip needs a team to help prepare the little theatre for its festival performance. The posters are torn and the paper cast needs making. Children look closely, share what they know and bring the stage to life together in The Missing Pumpkin Light, a Paper Adventure story.
en.storyNote: A friendly paper story played at a table. The lantern is printed artwork: no real lamp or flame is needed.
en.playTitle: Five connected activities, one shared performance
en.playIntro: These are activities in the complete game pack. The adult keeps later clues and the ending until their turn.
missions: Look for paper clues
Use the printed viewer and compare the torn edges.
Make the paper cast
Fold paper actors with an adult handling the scissors.
Share what you know
Listen to separate clues and agree how to arrange the stage.
Practise together
Match spoken cues to the paper theatre and take turns.
Perform the festival scene
Follow the final script and complete the performance together.
en.groupTitle: Plan for the children at your table
groups: Prepare one complete team set. Rotate reading, making, cue calling and checking so everyone has an action.
Prepare two complete sets for two balanced teams. One adult may guide the teams in turn.
Read the Host Guide, prepare the cuts, help with reading and check each task before sharing the next pile.
en.groupNote: Use it for a family table or a small Halloween gathering. This is the Home edition; classroom use has separate games and licences.
steps: Choose English or Chinese, then choose A4 or US Letter for both files.
Read the Host Guide and print the Player materials. Print one copy of the required lantern master from Host Guide page 18 for each team, even if you read the rest on screen.
Prepare the adult cuts and keep each team's materials together in checkpoint piles. Keep later clues and the ending with the host.
Introduce the story, share the first pile and invite children to read, point, make and explain.
Check each result before handing over the next task. Finish with the guided performance and collect the reusable paper pieces.
en.insideTitle: See the kind of materials you receive
en.previewNote: Explore three actual Player Pack excerpts. The images show how the paper materials work and keep the complete clues and ending in the pack.
en.paid: The Halloween pack is a paid, one-time Home purchase. Check current availability and price on the game page.
questions: Do we need a dark room or a real lantern?
No. The theatre uses printed paper pictures and windows. No real light, flame or dark room is required.
Can the children play without an adult?
An adult hosts, prepares the cuts, supports reading and checks the results. The guide contains hints, answers and the ending and stays with the adult.
Does a group of twelve share one set?
Prepare two complete sets for two balanced teams when there are 7–12 children. Use one set for 2–6 children.
Which language and paper size should I choose?
Select the English or Chinese edition and use the same A4 or US Letter size for the Player Pack and Host Guide. The website language and the downloaded edition are separate choices.
Can I print only the Player Pack?
The adult must read the Host Guide, and its required lantern master must also be printed. Follow the guide's preparation instructions even if you read the rest on screen.
Can we try a free game first?
Yes. The complete Celebration Home birthday adventure is free and has its own Player Pack and Host Guide. It is a different story from this paid Halloween game.
en.finishTitle: Ready to plan your Halloween table?
en.finish: See the game, its actual materials and current purchase options before choosing your pack.

zh.title: 在家组织一场儿童万圣节纸上冒险
zh.intro: 万圣节小剧场即将开演，皮普还需要大家帮忙。一起寻找纸上线索、制作演员、分享信息，用合作完成一场节日演出。适合6–12岁儿童，由成人带领。
zh.storyTitle: 海报被撕破了，小剧场等待开演。
zh.story: 在 Paper Adventure 的《找回南瓜灯》中，皮普需要一支合作小队，为节日演出做好准备。海报被撕破，纸演员也需要大家亲手制作。孩子们仔细观察、分享各自知道的信息，一起让纸舞台动起来。
zh.storyNote: 全程在桌面上完成。南瓜灯是一张打印图画，无需真实灯具或火焰。
zh.playTitle: 五个相连的活动，完成一场合作演出
zh.playIntro: 以下活动来自完整游戏包。后续线索和结局由成人保管，按关卡顺序发放。
missions: 观察纸上线索
使用纸观察框，比较撕裂边缘的特征。
制作纸演员
折叠纸演员，由成人负责使用剪刀。
分享各自的信息
听取不同线索，一起商量舞台的安排。
练习听提示配合
把口头提示与纸剧场联系起来，轮流参与。
完成节日演出
跟随最后的剧本，合作完成小剧场表演。
zh.groupTitle: 根据参加人数安排你的小队
groups: 准备一套完整小队材料。轮换朗读、制作、报提示和核对工作，让每个孩子都有参与动作。
准备两套完整材料，分成两支人数均衡的小队。一位成人可以轮流引导两队。
先读成人指南，完成剪裁，帮助阅读；核对当前任务后，再发放下一份材料。
zh.groupNote: 适合家庭桌面活动或小型万圣节聚会。如果在课堂使用，可以选择单独的课堂版游戏。
zh.prepareTitle: 成人需要提前准备什么
steps: 选择英文或中文版，并为两个文件选择相同的A4或US Letter纸型。
先读成人主持指南并打印玩家材料。成人指南第 18 页的南瓜灯模板，每队都必须打印一张，即使指南其余部分在屏幕上阅读。
由成人完成剪裁，按关卡分堆保管每队的材料。后续线索和结局先留在成人手中。
介绍故事，发放第一份材料，邀请孩子用朗读、指认、制作和解释等方式参与。
逐关核对后再继续，最后完成指南带领的演出，并收拢可重复使用的纸材料。
zh.insideTitle: 先看看你会用到哪类材料
zh.previewNote: 这三张图来自实际玩家材料，可以先了解纸道具怎么用。完整线索和结局留在游戏包里。
zh.paid: 万圣节家庭包为一次性购买的付费资料。当前价格和可购买状态请查看游戏详情页。
questions: 需要黑暗房间或真实南瓜灯吗？
不需要。剧场使用打印图画和纸窗，不需要真实灯具、火焰或黑暗房间。
孩子可以完全独立玩吗？
需要成人主持，完成剪裁、协助阅读和核对。指南含提示、答案和结局，应由成人保管。
12名儿童可以共用一套材料吗？
7–12名儿童需准备两套完整材料，分成两支人数均衡的小队；2–6名儿童使用一套。
如何选择语言和纸型？
选择英文或中文资料，并为玩家材料及成人指南使用相同的A4或US Letter纸型。网站界面语言和下载资料的语言是分别选择的。
只打印玩家材料就可以了吗？
成人必须先读主持指南，并打印其中必需的南瓜灯模板。即使其余指南在屏幕上阅读，也要按指南完成准备。
可以先试玩一个免费游戏吗？
可以。完整的庆典家庭版生日冒险免费提供玩家材料与成人指南。它与这款付费万圣节游戏是不同的故事。
